android_mechanism: UI state (paint) updated when nothing visually changed; fix skips redundant updates
bug_description: The now-playing page assigns the raw millisecond position from AVPlayer's timeUpdate callback into a page-level @State on every callback (~10/s). The whole player page (cover image, title, slider, controls) re-renders at callback frequency although the slider position and time labels only visibly change once per second, wasting UI-thread CPU throughout playback.
fix_summary: The state is assigned only when the whole-second part of the position changes.

test_oracle.definition: raw-instruction-retired sample count attributed to the app process during the measured step, aggregated from perf.data (HapRay perf.db instruction counts).
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed over >= 3 rounds per variant

mechanism_oracle.definition: Count of page state updates / render passes attributable to currentValue during 60s idle playback, plus UI-thread CPU time.
mechanism_oracle.comparison: unfixed ~600 updates/minute vs fixed ~60/minute; unfixed UI CPU during playback > fixed.

reproduction: git -C hosts/ytmusic checkout case/ytmusic_current_playing_timeupdate/unfixed; apply the measurement harness patch for this case, build, sign and install the HAP.
git -C hosts/ytmusic checkout case/ytmusic_current_playing_timeupdate/fixed; rebuild, reinstall and repeat identically.
Compare test_oracle.metric across the two report sets: unfixed >= 1.2 * fixed.
